brief_item.title: 闭式线性映射复用跨模型KVCache，减少重复Prefill
brief_item.core_conclusion: 研究同一模型家族切换时的KVCache复用，让接收模型使用源模型缓存，跳过重新Prefill。六组模型中，四组保留独立Prefill准确率73%至98%，两组Ministral为42%至44%。
brief_item.mechanism: 方法按目标层和注意力头拟合岭回归，从预测性最强的源层取Top-k特征。映射前去除源RoPE，再施加目标RoPE，校准使用500条FineWeb-Edu序列，每条1024个Token。
brief_item.result: Qwen3 14B到32B中，单源层解释目标Key方差56%，多源层升至79%，Value方差由32%升至65%。64到32768个Token序列上，映射比重新Prefill快4到25倍，反向切换快3到7倍。
brief_item.boundary: 仅评估Qwen3、Llama 3.1和Ministral 3的六组同家族、匹配KV配置，未测跨家族或KV维度不匹配。CodeAlpaca等领域偏移会降低准确率，且未测跨进程传输成本。
brief_item.project_relevance: 同家族模型切换可用方向性映射减少重复Prefill。落地前按模型对保存映射，用领域样本验准确率，再测量跨进程KVCache传输成本。

facts.title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
facts.event_hint: Within-family cross-model KV-cache transfer using a closed-form per-head ridge mapper
facts.problem: Model switching for cost-quality cascading, routing, or mid-conversation handoff forces the receiver to re-prefill accumulated context. The paper studies whether a source model's KV cache can be transformed into the target model's format so decoding can skip re-prefill.
facts.mechanism: For matched-KV model pairs, the method fits independent per-target-layer/head ridge regressions from top-k predictive source layers. It strips source RoPE before mapping and re-applies target RoPE, using 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens for calibration; the resulting closed-form mapper is gradient-free and position-independent across supported context lengths.

evidence.claim: On Qwen3 14B→32B, one source layer explains 56% of target-key variance and 32% of value variance; multiple source layers raise these to 79% and 65%.
evidence.source_locator: PDF p.1 abstract; p.2 linear-structure paragraph

evidence.claim: Across six matched-KV pairs in three model families, the linear mapper retains 73–98% of standalone accuracy on the four highest-retention pairs, while two Ministral pairs fall to 42–44% average retention.
evidence.value: 73–98% for four pairs; 42–44% for two pairs
evidence.condition: five accuracy benchmarks; selected k; within-family dense full-attention models

evidence.claim: The mapper runs 4–25x faster small-to-large and 3–7x faster large-to-small than receiver re-prefill across sequence lengths from 64 to 32,768 tokens.
Replacing ridge with an MLP recovers 24.3–36.8 percentage points of HellaSwag retention on the two failure pairs.
The study evaluates only matched-KV, within-family transfer; mismatched-KV pairs and cross-family transfer remain untested.
evidence.condition: six evaluated pairs across Qwen3, Llama 3.1, and Ministral 3

facts.evaluation_context: Experiments cover Qwen3, Llama 3.1, and Ministral 3 dense full-attention families with matched KV-head count and per-head dimension. Accuracy uses ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, MMLU, and GSM8K; multi-turn handoff uses CoQA. Latency appendix measurements use one 8×H100 NVLink node, bf16, 50 warmups and 30 timed trials per cell.
facts.limitations: The method is evaluated only on six matched-KV within-family pairs and does not test mismatched KV dimensions or cross-family transfer. Calibration uses FineWeb-Edu; domain shifts (especially CodeAlpaca) can reduce accuracy. k selection overlaps with some reported benchmarks, and latency measurements use synthetic inputs without measuring end-to-end shipping of the mapped cache to the target process.
facts.project_relevance: This provides a concrete path to avoid repeated prefill when an Agent or serving router switches among same-family models, but requires directional mapper storage and a transferability screen. The sharp Ministral failures and matched-KV restriction make per-pair validation essential before cross-domain deployment.
source_notes: The arXiv v1 PDF and all referenced chunks were fetched; evidence locators refer to PDF pages and sections.
Numbers are copied from the paper with their baselines and conditions; no candidate-summary-only claims were used.
